label: Via MAXIME_2 (greatest degree), a MAXIME_1 being causes being in all others
description: MAXIME_2 branch: some being has the GREATEST degree of being; a GREATEST-degree bearer of a perfection causes it in every other bearer (instantiated at esse); and the explicit sense bridge says a GREATEST-degree bearer of being is MAXIMAL in being. So some MAXIMAL being causes being in every other being. The control model without the bridge has a GREATEST bearer that something exceeds.
